_comment: Perk shaping rules for the weapon proficiency system.
Everything here is data. The engine reads it and applies it; changing a cost, a
requirement or a value per rank never needs a rebuild. Edit this file and run
'/reload proficiencies' on a running server.
PROVENANCE OF THE NUMBERS
Sourced from the Summer Update 2026 (15.30) notes:
- two shapeable slots per weapon
- first slot: 250 dust, proficiency level 3
- second slot: 1000 dust, weapon mastered
- a freshly shaped slot rolls its effect at the lowest value (rank 0)
- reshape offers three options at the current rank
- refine raises the rank one step at a time, each step costing more
- all shaping happens inside a protection zone
NOT yet sourced, PLACEHOLDER VALUES pending the official Perk Shaping Options
page: RefineDustCostPerRank, ReshapeDustCost, ClearDustCost, the option list
and every ValuePerRank table below.
OPTIONS
'Type' is a WeaponProficiencyBonus_t (src/enums/weapon_proficiency.hpp).
'ValuePerRank' is indexed by rank: entry 0 is what a freshly shaped slot rolls,
the last entry is that option's maximum rank. Tables may differ in length.
'Weight' is the relative draw chance among the options a roll may pick from.
'Unit' and 'TypeName' are documentation only, kept honest by the validator.
Percent values are FRACTIONS: 0.10 is 10%, writing 10 means 1000%.
